$comment: Publishing rules for the AIM charity directory. The build reads ONLY the fields listed under allowlist + controlFields from Airtable, publishes ONLY allowlist fields, and applies publishConditions both in the Airtable filter formula and again in code.

stealthConditions.$comment: Charities counted (never named) as 'in stealth mode'. Only the aggregate count is published: a total, plus a per-cause count for the causes in publishCauses. No other field of these records is fetched or written.

controlFields.$comment: Fetched so the publish rules can be re-checked in code and founders joined to charities; never written to the output.

images.$comment: Logos: uniform borders trimmed, then fitted inside maxWidth x maxHeight (never enlarged). Photos: square crop. Everything except SVG is re-encoded as WebP.
